families.decision: Organic soy foods labelled naturally fermented, with a short ingredient list.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and a named small brewer or producer on the label.
Read 'naturally fermented' or 'traditionally brewed' on the pack.
Check the ingredient list for whole soybeans, named grains, salt and cultures.
Skip sauces listing hydrolysed soy protein, caramel colour or added flavourings.

families.decision: Organic bone broth and soups made with it, from a named pasture-based farm.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal, a farm name and pasture-raised wording.
Read the broth ingredients for bones and the animal species.
Pick short recipes of broth, meat, vegetables, herbs and salt.
Skip lists with MSG, hydrolysed protein or flavour powders.

families.decision: Organic ferments labelled unpasteurised, from a named small producer.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and the name of a local farm or small fermenter.
Read 'fermented' plus 'live cultures' or 'unpasteurised' on the label.
Check the pack's refrigeration instructions and the store's display.
Pick short recipes of named whole foods, salt, spices and optional cultures.

families.decision: Organic herbs, spices and sea vegetables with named species and origins.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and a named grower or harvester on the pack.
Read the plant name and country or harvest region on the label.
Pick intact leaves or whole pieces where the form allows.
Skip damp packs and ingredient lists with added colours or flavourings.

families.decision: Organic fruit preparations with no added sweetener and a named fruit source.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and a named farm or growing region.
Read the ingredients for the fruit itself, with plain water where needed.
Check the label for added sugar, syrup or sweetening juice concentrate.
Pick a small producer named on the pack and follow its storage label.

families.decision: Organic whole-grain baking labelled sprouted or fermented with sourdough starter.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and a named local baker or small bakery.
Read every flour ingredient for 'whole grain' or 'whole wheat'.
Check for sprouted whole flour or a stated sourdough fermentation process.
Pick short recipes with butter, olive oil or coconut oil when fat is added.

families.decision: Organic lime-treated corn masa foods with a short ingredient list.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and a named small tortilla maker.
Read 'nixtamalized', 'lime-treated corn' or 'corn treated with lime' on the pack.
Check added fats for coconut oil, pastured lard or ghee.
Skip lists with oil blends, flavour powders or artificial colours.

families.decision: Organic potato chips cooked in coconut oil, pastured lard or ghee.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and a named potato farm or small chip maker.
Read the fat line for coconut oil, pastured lard or ghee.
Pick the plain salted recipe with the shortest ingredient list.
Skip lists with unspecified oil blends, flavourings or artificial colours.

families.decision: Plain organic popcorn kernels from a named grower, for popping at home.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal on a sealed bag of popcorn kernels.
Read the ingredient line for popcorn alone.
Check for the grower's name, origin and a readable lot code.
Skip microwave bags and kits with oil or flavour packets.

families.decision: Organic nuts and seeds labelled soaked and dried or sprouted, from a named grower.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and a named grower or small producer.
Read 'soaked and dried' or 'sprouted' on the pack.
Pick plain nuts, seeds or mixtures with unsweetened dried fruit.
Skip ingredient lists with added oils, syrups, candy pieces or protein isolates.

families.decision: Organic beans, peas and lentils, plain or in simple cooked recipes.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and a named pulse grower or small producer.
Read the label for the bean, pea or lentil variety.
Check for 'soaked' or 'sprouted' plus 'cooked' on ready-to-eat pulse foods.
Pick plain dried pulses or short cooked recipes without gums or flavour powders.

families.decision: Organic salads and dressings made with extra virgin olive oil or cultured dairy.
buying_tips: Look for an organic seal and a named local kitchen or small maker.
Read the dressing ingredients for extra virgin olive oil or plain cultured dairy.
Check all mayonnaise and sauce subingredients for the named oils.
Skip lists with soybean, canola or unspecified vegetable-oil blends.

families.decision: Organic prepared meat from a named pasture-based farm, with a short recipe.
buying_tips: Look for organic, pasture-raised wording and a farm name on the label.
Check '100% grass-fed and grass-finished' for beef, lamb or goat.
Read the full meat, fat, seasoning and sauce ingredient lists.
Pick recipes with butter, ghee, olive oil, coconut oil or named animal fats.

hot_soy_sauce.decision: Organic, traditionally brewed soy sauce labelled raw or unpasteurised.
hot_soy_sauce.delta: 'Nama shoyu' means unpasteurised soy sauce; soybeans and wheat are named in its recipe.

canned_soup.decision: Organic canned soup with real bone broth, meat and vegetables in a short recipe.
canned_soup.delta: 'Ready to serve' on the can; follow its heating instructions.

olives.decision: Organic olives labelled naturally brine-fermented and unpasteurised.
olives.delta: Whole olives in water-and-salt brine; the label names the olive variety.

seaweed.decision: Organic, air-dried whole seaweed with a named species and harvest region.
seaweed.delta: Dulse comes as reddish leaves; nori is pressed into sheets.

salsa.decision: Organic fermented salsa labelled live and unpasteurised in the chilled case.
salsa.delta: Tomatoes, onions, peppers and cilantro in the recipe; pico de gallo has visible chopped pieces.

coconut_water.decision: Fresh water inside a whole organic coconut carrying an organic label.
coconut_water.delta: 'Not from concentrate' on packaged coconut water.

condiments.decision: Organic fermented ketchup or mustard labelled unpasteurised, from a small maker.
condiments.delta: Ketchup starts with tomatoes; mustard names mustard seed in its recipe.

crackers.decision: Organic whole-grain sourdough crackers with a short recipe and named bakery.
crackers.delta: Plain, tomato-basil or rosemary versions; check any sandwich filling separately.

tortilla_chips.decision: Organic nixtamalized corn chips cooked in coconut oil, pastured lard or ghee.
tortilla_chips.delta: Corn masa triangles; lime means calcium hydroxide in the corn treatment.

potato_chips.decision: Organic whole potato slices cooked in coconut oil, pastured lard or ghee.
potato_chips.delta: Potatoes, rather than potato flakes or potato starch, start the ingredient line.

popcorn.decision: Plain organic popcorn kernels in a sealed bag bearing the grower's name.
popcorn.delta: 'Mushroom' popcorn pops into domes; white and yellow types also come as butterfly kernels.

pretzels.decision: Organic sprouted whole-wheat pretzels with olive oil and a short ingredient list.
pretzels.delta: Split-open puffs or soft pretzels with a plain salt crust.

snack_bars.decision: Organic bars of soaked-and-dried nuts, seeds and dried fruit, without added syrup.
snack_bars.delta: A pressed bar with visible nuts, seeds and dried fruit.

trail_mix.decision: Organic soaked-and-dried nuts with unsweetened, unsulphured dried fruit.
trail_mix.delta: Loose nuts and fruit pieces; apricots labelled unsulphured.

snacks.decision: Plain organic soaked-and-dried nuts or seeds in a sealed pack.
snacks.delta: Whole nuts or seeds visible through the pack window.

hummus.decision: Organic hummus of cooked sprouted chickpeas, tahini, lemon and extra virgin olive oil.
hummus.delta: Cooked chickpeas and sesame tahini form the base; lemon and garlic flavour it.

deli_salads.decision: Organic cold-case salads with extra virgin olive oil dressing and a short recipe.
deli_salads.delta: A prepared-on or use-by date on the salad tub; all dressing ingredients printed.

prepared_meals.decision: Organic pastured meat and vegetable meals with a short, fully printed recipe.
prepared_meals.delta: Recognisable meat and vegetable pieces; reheating directions printed on the meal pack.

groups.title: Whole-grain crackers and pretzels
groups.why_same: Both use the same organic seal, whole-flour, sprouting or sourdough, and added-fat checks.
